s.note: First the magician shows you something ordinary. White bread, mint butter, salted cucumber.
s.how: Peel the cucumber, slice it paper thin, toss with the salt and leave in a sieve for 10 minutes, then pat dry. Beat the butter with the mint and a little lemon zest. Butter every slice, lay the cucumber over half of them, add white pepper and close. Cut off the crusts and cut each sandwich into three neat fingers.

s.n: Birdcage devilled quail eggs with cress
s.note: Borden wrecks Angier's bird act. Quail eggs, mustard yolks, cayenne, cress.
s.how: Lower the quail eggs into boiling water for 2 and a half minutes, then plunge into iced water. Peel carefully, halve lengthways and tip the yolks into a bowl. Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard and a pinch of salt. Pipe back into the whites, dust with cayenne and top with cress.

m.n: Fallon's twin chicken and leek pies
m.note: Two men sharing one life. Matching pies, chicken, leek, tarragon cream.
m.how: Brown the chicken in the butter, then add the leeks and cook until soft. Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream and mustard, and simmer until thick; add the tarragon and cool a little. Divide between 2 identical small pie dishes, top each with pastry, crimp and brush with egg. Bake at 200C until puffed and deep gold, then serve the two side by side.

m.n: Don't-forget-your-hat roast beef with Yorkshire puddings
m.note: Tesla tells Angier not to forget his hat. Rare roast sirloin, top hat puddings, gravy.
m.how: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter and rest it. Rub the beef with the oil, mustard, salt and pepper and roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then at 180C until rare in the middle. Rest the beef and turn the oven up to 230C; heat a little oil in each hole of a deep muffin tin until smoking. Pour in the batter and bake, without opening the door, until tall like top hats. Stir the extra flour into the roasting tin juices, whisk in the stock and boil into gravy; serve the beef sliced with puddings, gravy and horseradish.

w.n: The prestige: Victoria sponge, sliced and restored
w.note: What vanished comes back. Butter sponge, raspberry jam, vanilla cream.
w.how: Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time. Fold in the flour, milk and half the vanilla and divide between 2 lined 20cm tins. Bake at 180C until springy and golden, then cool on a rack. Whip the cream with the rest of the vanilla. Spread one sponge with jam and cream, put the other on top, dust with icing sugar, then cut it in front of everyone and put it back together.

d.note: Tesla's machine crackles in Colorado. London dry gin, tonic, lime. Glows under black light.
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice and pour 40ml gin into each. Top with tonic, add a squeeze of lime and stir once. Turn off the lights and shine a black light torch on the glasses: the tonic glows blue.
